name: Blossom
source:
Blossom is the third romance option in Lovewood. 
She is a farmer in the town of Liebwald, living next-door to the protagonist. She is shown to have a long-lasting friendship with Moth, the tailor, and takes a lot of pride in her wool bunnies.
